data.title: 卡提希娅 · 雨廊下的躲雨与烤面包
data.description: 小镇面包房檐下躲雨，店主认出她塞来刚出炉的面包；她抱着温热的纸袋小口啃着，光环也挡不住那股普通的、属于小镇女孩的幸福。
data.action: 小镇面包房檐下躲雨，店主认出她塞来刚出炉的面包
data.promptProse: Cartethyia shelters under the bakery eaves in a pale blue dress and cream cardigan, her long blond braid lit by the shop doorway. Inside the door, a gray-haired older woman in a brown baker's apron leans forward to hand her a paper bag of fresh bread. Their hands meet at the fold above the rain-dark threshold.
data.animaCaption: Long-blond-haired Cartethyia receives the warm paper bag from the gray-haired baker in a brown apron. The woman stays just inside the doorway while Cartethyia stands beneath the awning.
